parent_objective: audit matched-budget config materialization before any training execution design
blocked_by: M2227 generated configs and command matrix must be audited before training execution
supersedes: directly running generated training commands without result audit

public_gates: M2228 must audit M2227 summary result_class and counts
M2228 must verify generated_config_count=15 and training_matrix_row_count=15
M2228 must verify all trained profiles share the same seed set and budget signature
M2228 must verify contract_violation_count=0 and guardrail_violation_count=0
M2228 must verify training_started=false and no reset rollout replay PPO measured execution or policy action occurred
M2228 must decide whether a separate training-execution command design is admissible
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits deterministic matched-budget config and command artifacts before admitting training execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no training rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if generated counts do not match M2226 design
stop if budgets or seeds differ across trainable profiles
stop if M2227 guardrails show training, reset, rollout, replay, PPO, measured execution, or policy action
fallback_plan: route to config materialization repair if counts, budgets, or seeds fail
route to contract repair if actor input guardrails fail
route to training-execution command design if the audit is clean

training_stage.stage_objective: audit no-training matched-budget profile config materialization
admission_evidence: M2227 generated 15 trainable profile/seed configs and 15 training command rows
allowed_updates: M2228 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2228 audits config artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2228.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Audit must preserve blocked ranking and self-ID claims even when config artifacts are clean.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: checks whether matched-budget training artifacts are admissible for a separate execution design
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: protects fair profile training setup before comparison data exists
must_synthesize_if: M2228 cannot admit training execution design
M2228 finds training or rollout already happened during materialization

hypothesis: M2227 materialization artifacts are clean enough to admit a separate matched-budget training-execution command design, while still blocking direct training and ranking claims.
success_criteria: no reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: M2227 config or command counts differ from M2226 design
budget or seed signatures differ across profiles
contract or guardrail violations are nonzero
training execution design is admitted despite artifact inconsistencies

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual artifact audit of runs/m2227_paper_route_current_sim_matched_budget_profile_training_configs/summary.json and generated configs

decision_rule: M2228 passes if M2227 artifacts are count-, budget-, seed-, contract-, and guardrail-clean, and routes only to a separate training-execution command design.
